description: Renders a signature or initials signing step inside the shared step shell. Signing redesign phase 2: the form runner renders this wrapper instead of a bare TmSignatureCapture, so a signature step carries the step title, the required / optional badge, the signing instruction and the "appears on" hint like every other step. The capture is wrapped in a role=group element named by the step title id. The shell owns the required / invalid presentation of the step (the badge, the single role=alert validation message and aria-invalid), so the embedded capture is deliberately driven with Required = false — a required signature step shows exactly one "signature is required" alert.

parameters.name: Field
parameters.description: Signing field represented by this step.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Current signature value (typed text, drawn SVG or uploaded data URL).

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the signature value changes.

parameters.name: Initials
parameters.description: Whether the capture draws initials instead of a full signature. Defaults to the field type.

parameters.name: ModeChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the capture mode changes.

parameters.name: Modes
parameters.description: Offered capture modes. Defaults to draw, type and upload.

parameters.name: ClearButtonPlacement
parameters.description: Where the capture's Clear button renders. Defaults to Overlay (Signing redesign phase 4): the button sits on the signing surface itself instead of a row below it. Hosts can restore the row with TmSignatureClearButtonPlacement.Actions.

parameters.name: ValidationMessage
parameters.description: Validation message shown by the step shell below the capture.

parameters.name: AppearsOn
parameters.description: Short text describing where the field appears in the document.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve localized field text.

parameters.name: FallbackCulture
parameters.description: Fallback culture used when localized field text is missing.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the shell element.
